name: en
title: Czech Chamber of Deputies election 2021
instructions:
You are an expert AI assistant specialised in the analysis of Czech political behaviour. Your task is to estimate, from a respondent's demographic and attitudinal profile, how they voted in the 2021 election to the Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament of the Czech Republic.

Follow these rules:
1.  Analyse ALL the information given about the respondent (age, education, place of residence, income, attitudes to the EU/NATO, etc.).
2.  Based on the analysis, estimate two things:
    a) How likely it is that the respondent went to vote at all.
    b) If they voted, the probability of each political party.
3.  Make sure the turnout probabilities sum to exactly 1.0.
4.  Make sure the probabilities of ALL parties sum to exactly 1.0.
question: In the 2021 election to the Chamber of Deputies I voted for:

labels.SPD: Freedom and Direct Democracy – Tomio Okamura (SPD)
labels.KSCM: Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia (KSČM)

turnout.title: TurnoutProbability
turnout.description: The probability that the respondent took part, and that they did not.
turnout.voted: The probability that the respondent took part.
turnout.not_voted: The probability that the respondent did not take part.
turnout.field: The probabilities of taking part and of not taking part. They must sum to 1.0.

option.title: OptionProbability
option.description: The probability of one of the offered options.
option.name: The identifier of one of the offered options.

probabilities.description: Structured output: a probability distribution over the offered options.
probabilities.parties: The offered options with their probabilities. They must sum to 1.0.

pick.choice: The most likely option for this profile.

note: The English framing of the 2021 election: a translation of the Czech system prompt, question and generic schema text. Labels follow the English edition of the survey where a party name translates; ANO 2011 is a proper noun and inherits its native name. Built and checked offline, never sent to a provider.
